name: Bloodwatcher Point
summary: Bloodwatcher Point is a modest Horde outpost situated in the rugged wastes of the Badlands, positioned just south of the ancient Tomb of the Watchers. Serving travelers navigating the harsh desert, the camp offers an essential foothold and staging ground within an arid frontier contested by hostile beasts, dark iron dwarves, and ancient titan machinery.

sections.title: A Horde Foothold in the Dust
sections.body: Tucked among the crags of the Badlands northwest of Camp Boff, Bloodwatcher Point provides a vital waystation for the Horde in a desolate region dominated by dust, rock elementals, and territorial beasts. Formed of sturdy canvas tents, transport wagons, and emblazoned banners, the encampment offers respite and a secure base of operations. Perched directly south of the enigmatic Tomb of the Watchers, it allows scouts and emissaries to keep an eye on curious excavations and encroaching rivals, serving as an anchor in a land with few friendly faces.

faq.answer: Bloodwatcher Point lies in the southern-central expanse of the Badlands. It sits directly south of the Tomb of the Watchers and northwest of the ogre settlement at Camp Boff.

faq.q: What services are available at Bloodwatcher Point?
aliases: is there a flight master at bloodwatcher point
faq.answer: The encampment functions as an operational waystation for the Horde in the Badlands, featuring canvas shelters, supply wagons, and flight master services to connect travelers across the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why is the camp situated near the Tomb of the Watchers?
aliases: why camp near tomb of watchers
faq.answer: Its proximity to the Tomb of the Watchers allows Horde forces to monitor subterranean titan ruins and keep watch over neighboring threats like ogres, troggs, and rival expeditions scouring the arid canyon lands.

angles.text: The arid Badlands offer few safe havens for Horde wanderers, making this fortified encampment an essential resupply post and strategic staging ground south of Khaz Modan.
